build_SIREN_network: build a SIREN neural network with sine activations and configurable layer sizes for continuous representation learning
create_SINESmearing_basis: create a SINESmearing module to encode input features using exponentially spaced sine frequency embeddings
create_GaussianSmearing_basis: create a GaussianSmearing module to encode input features using Gaussian radial basis function embeddings
create_Basis_module: create a Basis module with configurable smearing types including powersine, fouriersine, gauss, and spherical harmonics
create_SphericalSmearing_harmonics: create a SphericalSmearing module to compute real-valued spherical harmonics from normalized 3D direction vectors
